Apple___Apple_scab.symptoms: Olive-green to velvety black circular lesions on leaf surfaces; deformed, cracked fruit and premature defoliation.
Apple___Apple_scab.causes: High relative humidity (>80%), leaf wetness duration exceeding 6 hours, splashing rain/irrigation, and overwintering fungal phytopathogen spores in crop debris.
Apple___Apple_scab.organic_treatment: Prune and destroy infected leaves immediately. Spray OMRI-listed Copper Octanoate or Bacillus subtilis bio-fungicide every 7-10 days.
Apple___Apple_scab.chemical_treatment: Protectant Captan or Myclobutanil sprays timed from green-tip through petal fall.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Practice 2-3 year non-host crop rotation, sanitize pruning shears with 70% isopropyl alcohol, and switch from overhead sprinklers to drip irrigation.
Apple___Apple_scab.sdg_impact: Directly advances UN SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) by preventing 20-40% preventable crop loss and UN SDG 15 (Life on Land) via precision targeted treatment.

Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Characteristic foliar lesions of Early blight on Tomato: progressive chlorotic yellowing, necrotic brown/black spots, or pustules reducing photosynthetic surface area.
Tomato___Early_blight.causes: High relative humidity (>80%), leaf wetness duration exceeding 6 hours, splashing rain/irrigation, and overwintering fungal phytopathogen spores in crop debris.
